paper_title: Extensive search for axion dark matter over 1\,GHz with CAPP's Main Axion eXperiment
notes: Paper reports new axion-photon coupling exclusion limits from CAPP-MAX cavity haloscope over 1.025-1.185 GHz (4.24-4.91 ueV). Local DM density assumed 0.45 GeV/cm^3 (from Eq.1).
